name: Improve MCTS vectorization, cache locality, and throughput

description: Establish Criterion baseline across representative MCTS, tree, rollout, and state workloads

asi.hypothesis: A geometric mean of representative existing Criterion workloads provides broad backpressure against overfitting while full tests preserve behavior.
asi.measurement_issue: Hard-coded Criterion group durations override CLI measurement-time, making each loop about 82 seconds; replace only the harness with an equivalent fixed-work custom timer before optimization.

name: Improve MCTS throughput and cache locality (fixed-work harness)

description: Establish fast fixed-work baseline matching representative Criterion cases

asi.hypothesis: Batched five-round medians over the same positions and iteration counts preserve broad optimization signal while reducing loop time enough for many experiments.
asi.measurement_design: Pinned to CPU 0; includes four end-to-end searches, deep and wide synthetic tree shapes, UTTT rollout, and UTTT step; complete tests run outside the metric.
asi.criterion_crosscheck: Fixed-work medians are close to the original Criterion estimates for all large workloads; step differs slightly because nanosecond-scale harness overhead is proportionally larger.

description: Hoist parent log and score each UCB child once, but regress one-child chains

asi.hypothesis: A direct one-pass maximum can halve UCB score evaluations and hoist the parent logarithm out of wide sibling scans.
asi.finding: Wide-512 improved about 71% and TTT searches about 50%, confirming repeated max_by scoring and logarithms dominate wide scans.
asi.rollback_reason: Deep-chain selection regressed about 39% because max_by never invokes its comparator for a single child, while the replacement unnecessarily computed ln and sqrt at every chain level.
asi.next_action_hint: Reapply the direct scan with an immediate return when the child slice has exactly one entry; preserve the wide-path optimization.

description: Score each UCB child once and fast-path single-child selection

asi.hypothesis: A direct one-pass maximum with a single-child fast path removes repeated UCB calculations without penalizing narrow trees.
asi.result: Primary improved 31.8%; wide-512 improved 71.2%, TTT searches 49-55%, UTTT searches 4-12%, and deep-chain improved 4.2%.
asi.mechanism: The scan computes each child score once and computes parent ln once; the one-child path performs no floating-point score work, matching max_by's prior behavior.
asi.behavior_preserved: Tie handling explicitly keeps the last equal-scoring child, matching Iterator::max_by; full tests pass.
